title: Duolingo case studies: character response
summary: Teach an original character response tied to a factual event, with anticipation, action, follow-through and a clear rest.
use_when: A meaningful learning achievement or companion interaction has a defensible character concept and a bounded moment to respond.
avoid_when: Every routine action would perform, an urgent failure needs immediate correction, or the character contradicts the actual outcome.
